channel.description: Latest articles from KCBS | CBS LA (cbsla.com)

item.title: The Uplift: New York to Florida
item.description: Two New Yorkers bring their business to Florida to introduce the sunshine state to Big Apple food staples. Plus, a powerful story from David Begnaud about a mother-son duo who are using their life experience to help others.

item.title: The Uplift: Landman lesson
item.description: A professor in Texas cleverly incorporates the popular Paramount+ show "Landman" into his lesson plan. A stranger becomes a friend after he heroically saves an elderly couple. Plus, more heartwarming news.

item.title: The Uplift: Daddy daughter dance
item.description: David Begnaud takes us to a Louisiana prison where fatherhood is the focus. He meets inmates who got the chance to take part in a daddy-daughter dance and reconnect with their kids. Plus, more heartwarming news.

item.title: The Uplift: America the beautiful
item.description: To mark the 250th anniversary of the United States this year, we are sharing what makes the country great from A to Z. This week, sixth graders share why they find America beautiful.

item.title: The Uplift: New beginnings
item.description: A boy who faced life-changing challenges gets by with help from his friends. A group of retired teachers gets together to continue the passion of helping kids. Plus, more good news.

item.title: The Uplift: A surprise from Shaq
item.description: Shaquille O'Neal steps in to a young 7-foot-3 police recruit from Texas. Plus, a behind-the-scenes look at the reality competition show "The Traitors," and more heartwarming news.

item.title: California avalanche near Lake Tahoe is among the deadliest in U.S. history
item.description: An avalanche near California's Lake Tahoe​ has become the fourth deadliest in U.S. history. Here's what we know about the six deadliest slides.

item.title: 2/18: CBS Evening News
item.description: Deadliest American avalanche in over 40 years kills 8, 1 still missing; New, dramatic testimony in Colin Gray’s second-degree murder trial

item.title: Judge holds DOJ lawyer in contempt as tensions flare over immigration cases
item.description: A Minnesota federal judge ordered a government attorney to be held in civil contempt of court, further escalating tension between the judiciary and Trump administration over immigration cases.

item.title: 8 skiers dead after avalanche near California's Lake Tahoe; 9th still missing
item.description: The avalanche was reported near Castle Peak in Nevada County, north of Boreal Mountain Ski Resort.
